tvShow.name: Love Is Blind: UK
tvShow.overview: Emma and Matt Willis host a social experiment where British singles look for love and get engaged before meeting in person. But who will say "I do"?

episodes.name: The Pods Are Open
episodes.overview: The pods are open for this season's singles. While some take time to choose a partner or make a connection, one's quickly ready to go down on one knee.

episodes.name: Two's a Couple, Three's a Love Triangle
episodes.overview: As connections deepen, the singles start to open up to each other and share their vulnerabilities. But is everybody really who they say they are?

episodes.name: He's Here for Fame
episodes.overview: Two more couples prepare to meet face-to-face. With one contestant reeling from a shocking allegation, she's faced with the hardest decision of her life.

episodes.name: We Had Sex... Twice!
episodes.overview: Two tangled love triangles are straightened out, but one new fiancee already has doubts. The couples fly to Corfu to put their connections to the test.

episodes.name: I Made a Mistake
episodes.overview: As the couples mingle with each other for the first time, sparks seem to be rekindling between two contestants, leaving someone's fiancee out in the cold.

episodes.name: Once a Cheat, Always a Cheat
episodes.overview: On the last day on Corfu, the couples discuss their futures — and pasts. For one pair, it's the pressures of the present that are almost overwhelming.

episodes.name: Is She Good Enough for You?
episodes.overview: Back in the UK, the couples settle into each other's worlds and meet their family and friends. Some are supportive, others have some questions.

episodes.name: Guess Who's Back
episodes.overview: The couples meet with the pod squad, seeing faces they hadn't seen in weeks — or at all. The return of one single stirs up drama for more than one pair.

episodes.name: He Wants a Prenup
episodes.overview: With just days before the big day, things are getting serious. Even as they try on their wedding outfits, doubts are growing in some people's minds.

episodes.name: See You at the Altar
episodes.overview: After the couples' stag and hen dos, each future bride and groom must decide if their journey together is coming to an end — or if it's just beginning.

episodes.name: We're Not Ready
episodes.overview: The remaining couples meet at the altar, faced with a life-altering decision: either say "I do" to their partner, or to walk away forever.

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: One year after the weddings, Emma and Matt host the six couples — and one surprise guest — as they unpack all the drama from the pods to the present.

episodes.name: Eat, Sleep, Date, Repeat
episodes.overview: A new batch of singles enter the pods. One pair instantly find a spiritual connection, while someone has reservations about his potential partner's job.

episodes.name: This Is How Triangles Are Formed
episodes.overview: Honest conversations lead to deeper connections — and even the big question. Love triangles are formed, and one is broken just as quickly.

episodes.name: Trust My Spleen
episodes.overview: One single is torn between two solid connections. Another makes it clear he's made up his mind — and someone starts to doubt the message from his spleen.

episodes.name: She Changed Her Mind Overnight
episodes.overview: Hearts are broken and jaws are dropped as dramatic decisions are made. Five newly engaged couples jet off to Cyprus and spend their first night together.

episodes.name: I Don’t Want to Be a Villain
episodes.overview: It's the last day in paradise before returning to reality. One fiancée starts to question her decision, while others can't wait to take the next step.

episodes.name: Good Guys Finish Last
episodes.overview: The couples learn what life with their partner looks like — for better or worse. Someone meets with an old flame to discuss what went down in the pods.

episodes.name: You’re Trying to Get Me in Trouble
episodes.overview: With 14 days until the weddings, one couple's relationship is already under strain — and a reunion with the pod squad threatens to shatter it entirely.

episodes.name: Walking Away
episodes.overview: Even the strongest relationships feel the pressure from loved ones. One flirty fiancé's actions get back to his partner and incites a dramatic backlash.

episodes.name: Don’t Let Anyone Dim your Sparkle
episodes.overview: As the couples celebrate the stag and hen, one groom-to-be wrestles with doubts and cracks begin to show in another couple's relationship.

episodes.name: A Risk Worth Taking?
episodes.overview: As the remaining couples prepare for the biggest day of their lives, it's time for them to make the final decision about whether love is truly blind.

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: Who's saying "I still do?" Emma and Matt host this season's couples and special guests as tea is spilled and secrets are revealed in a fiery reunion.

episodes.name: After the Altar: You're still Married!
episodes.overview: Ahead of Kieran's 30th birthday bash, former participants catch up on the drama over dinners and drinks. Meanwhile, Jasmine and Bobby host a baby shower.

episodes.name: After the Altar: I'm Here To Cause Some Chaos
episodes.overview: Kieran and Megan are the first getaway arrivals, but drama soon follows as exes Katisha and Javen air out unresolved isssues, and Sarover snubs Kal.

episodes.name: After the Altar: Falling in Love with You More and More
episodes.overview: Jasmine and Bobby prepare for their firstborn. On the final night of the retreat, Billy and Ashleigh seek closure-but elsewhere, more conflict sparks.

episodes.name: Gotta Stop Telling These Girls I Love Them!
episodes.overview: Emma and Matt Willis open the pods to new singles. As the dates begin, several start to hit it off — and two love triangles begin to take shape.

episodes.name: You Can't Even Remember Her Name!
episodes.overview: Conversations spice up, spiritual connections form and walls begin to come down. A series of sentimental gestures lead to the pods' first proposal.

episodes.name: Is This Too Good to be True?
episodes.overview: More singles pop the question and fiancés prepare to meet. While someone stirs the pot in the living quarters, another is torn between two connections.

episodes.name: Wow, Wow, Wow, Wow, Wow!
episodes.overview: Tough decisions spark joy and heartbreak, before the fiancés jet off to an Ibiza retreat. Some are in paradise — but for two of them trouble is brewing.

episodes.name: I'm Anything But Boring
episodes.overview: At a pool party, the newly engaged couples mingle with past connections. Two former flames make a splash as they clash over their time in the pods.

episodes.name: If You Need to Walk Away, Walk Away
episodes.overview: The couples adjust to living together in London. While one fiancée feels left out in the cold, another's soon-to-be in-laws put them in the hot seat.

episodes.name: No-one is Butthurt
episodes.overview: Reality hits, boundaries are pushed and energy dwindles for some. At a birthday bash, a familiar face from the pods brings drama as a plus one.

episodes.name: I Look Like a Clown
episodes.overview: While more couples meet each other's loved ones, it's heartbreak for others — as one fiancé vanishes in the night and another delivers harsh truths.

episodes.name: Are You Ready for the Real Word?
episodes.overview: With just days to go until they say "I do," the couples try on wedding outfits. As they part ways for the stag and hen dos, it's time to let loose.

episodes.name: Do I Have Your Blessing?
episodes.overview: The remaining couples prepare to meet at the altar for a life-changing decision. Will they discover that love truly is blind - or will they walk away?

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: Hosted by Emma and Matt, the couples from this season reunite. Did they all split up, or did several find a happy ending?
